headline: Woman raped while sleeping on footpath in Comilla
summary: CCTV footage of the assault has gone viral, sparking outrage as a woman was targeted while she slept on the street.
details: A woman was raped while she was sleeping on a footpath in Comilla.
The incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera, and the footage has since gone viral on social media platforms.
The footage shows a man approaching the sleeping woman and committing the assault.
Local authorities are investigating the case as the viral video provides critical evidence of the crime.
